stratagems.name: Psychic Barrage
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on an unmodified Wound roll of 6, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: Warp Flame
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Aetheric Manipulation
stratagems.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
